title: Five months in Detroit, McCluskey's Tavern
summary: A photo of his in-laws' sons playing at a Detroit tavern where he worked about four months.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Uh, is there anything else... Did you see this, uh... What? This... No, I was going to ask some of these other pictures there if you could tell us about... That was made in Detroit.
That's the time I spent five months in Detroit. Mostly a young group, isn't it? Yeah, that's my nephews and my brother-in-law and his sons. There's one of them on the piano. There's another brother.
Instead of him standing up, he's... They were playing, you see? Yes, that's right. That picture was there, you see? Yeah, they used to play in... That was McCluskey's Tavern.
In Detroit, yeah. And they played three times a week. I worked there about four months. Uh-huh.
